mars_cartographic_standards.governing_body: IAU/IAG Working Group on Cartographic Coordinates and Rotational Elements (WGCCRE)
mars_cartographic_standards.reference_system: IAU 2000 / IAU 2015 Cartographic System for Mars

vertical_datum.name: MOLA Areoid Datum (GMM-2B Gravitational Equipotential Surface)
vertical_datum.definition: Gravitational potential surface where the mean equatorial radius equals 3,396,000 meters; approximates 6.105 mbar surface.
vertical_datum.reference_publication: Smith et al. (2001), Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter: Experiment summary and data processing, J. Geophys. Res.

coordinate_conventions.time_system: Local True Solar Time (LTST) and Martian Sols (since Perseverance landing Sol 0 = 2021-02-18)

equirectangular_jezero.name: Equirectangular_Mars_Jezero
equirectangular_jezero.usage: Standard projection for Mars 2020 landing site characterization and USGS Astropedia TRN products.
